newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - September 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - September 11.

text.p: Justice Minister G.L. Pieris says Tamil parties should give support to find permanent solution to ethnic problem while at same time demand only what can be given.
More than 100 Tamil refugees reach Rameshwaram in India from Mannar.
U.S. diplomat to meet Tamil parties to discuss political climate and proposed ban on LTTE.
Country will benefit from devolution, central province chief minister W.P.B. Dissanayake says.
Talks between Indian and Sri Lankan foreign ministers to be held in Colombo next month.
Female Tamil rebel caught with five pressure mines jailed for five years.
Fifty-one factories, mostly making garments, closed during the past year.
Police arrest two more train bomb suspects. More than 50 people were killed when Tamil Tiger rebels bombed a packed commuter train in Colombo in July.
